title: Turning on Order parts while See Financial Data is OFF asks you to also turn on See Financial Data
custom_preconds:
1. Open Create Role (or edit a custom role).
  2. In that role, See Financial Data is OFF and Order parts is OFF.
custom_steps:
1. Turn ON the Order parts toggle while See Financial Data is still OFF.
  2. Look at the prompt that appears.
  3. Accept the prompt.
  4. Save the role.
custom_expected:
Turning on Order parts shows a prompt that See Financial Data must also be turned on (Order parts needs See Financial Data).

Accepting turns See Financial Data on automatically.

The role saves with both Order parts and See Financial Data on.

You cannot end up with Order parts on while See Financial Data is off.
evidence: UI dialog: ticking Order parts while SFD off shows "Enable See Financial Data? — Order Parts requires See Financial Data. Enable it to grant this permission?" [Cancel|Enable].
